title: GPU3 thermal hotspot on r3n7 (ipmi gpu3_core_temp → 88°C)
summary: IPMI gpu3_core_temp on node r3n7 rose from ~45°C to ~88°C over 90 minutes, crossing the 84°C throttle threshold at ~13:30 UTC. Peer GPUs on r3n0–r3n6 remain 34–41°C. Node fans (fan0_0, fan1_0) ramped to ~6500 RPM.
notes: Drain r3n7 and inspect GPU3 cooling path / thermal paste.
